title: Home in Texas controllable, drivemeinsane.com
description: A privately hosted, user-controllable webcam showing the owner's Texas home. Exact location is intentionally obscured but the site is the namesake feed; the homepage doubles as the cam viewer with PTZ controls.
subject: A private home's exterior with controllable PTZ camera
notes: Site still resolves but cam backend has not been re-verified; classic entry from the early r/controllablewebcams days.

title: Flat Creek Inn, Jackson Hole Wyoming. My family owns this hotel and I got them to put up a webcam for you. Overlooks the Elk Refuge. (Not controllable)
description: YouTube live stream from the Flat Creek Inn in Jackson, Wyoming, overlooking the National Elk Refuge. Static view of the creek and surrounding fields; not PTZ controllable.
subject: National Elk Refuge / Flat Creek valley
notes: Originally a FlatCreekInn-hosted feed; re-broadcast on YouTube.

title: A lot of controllable cams from around the world
description: Aggregator site that indexes many user-controllable webcams worldwide. Not a single feed but a directory of PTZ-capable public cams.
subject: Directory of public PTZ cameras
notes: Aggregator; not a single cam.

title: My favorite uncontrollable cam- a marina in the UK. Looks like an idyllic scene from the Truman show
description: Static (non-controllable) AXIS webcam pointed at a UK marina. Long-running favourite of the subreddit for its calm, postcard-like harbour view.
isp: Private IP (192.171.163.3) - port forward on a UK marina
subject: Marina with moored boats
notes: Direct IP suggests a port-forwarded small-business cam. Truman Show comment repeated by several users.

title: 2x PTZ and 1x Underwater Camera (Victoria, BC)
description: Race Rocks Ecological Reserve camera system near Metchosin/Victoria, BC: two surface PTZ cameras looking at the Juan de Fuca inlet plus a unique underwater cam showing marine life and occasional scuba divers.
subject: Race Rocks marine ecological reserve (surface + underwater)
notes: Well-known educational cam hosted by racerocks.com. Underwater view is rare on the public internet.

title: Schooners Panama City Beach and BARS Live Cams (Not Controllable)
description: Static live cam on Schooners beach bar/restaurant in Panama City Beach, Florida. Views of the Gulf of Mexico beach and sunset, plus companion hill bar cam.
subject: Schooners beach bar and Gulf of Mexico
notes: Hosted on the tripsmarter.com cam platform.

title: EarthCam - Webcam Network from all over the World.
description: EarthCam.com is the world's largest commercial webcam aggregator and content network. Hosts thousands of construction cams, tourism cams, and city views across every continent.
subject: Aggregator of construction/tourism/traffic webcams worldwide
notes: Aggregator. Many feeds require paid subscription.

title: Abbey Road !
description: The famous Abbey Road zebra crossing cam in St John's Wood, London, hosted by EarthCam. 1920x1080 H.264 + AAC HLS stream, ~970 kbps; requires correct Referer/Origin headers due to hotlink protection.
subject: Abbey Road Studios zebra crossing (Beatles)
notes: Hotlink-blocked bare GET. Requires Referer/Origin headers from abbeyroad.com. See docs/ABBEY_ROAD_CAM.md.

title: Planjka Beach - Novalja Live Webcam
description: Live HD cam on Planjka/Trincel beach in Stara Novalja on the island of Pag, Croatia. Touristic static view of the Adriatic beach and sea.
subject: Planjka/Trincel beach, Adriatic
notes: Static cam hosted by SkylineWebcams aggregator.

title: Canadian Airport Weather Cams [uncontrollable]
description: NAV CANADA's network of METCAM airport weather webcams. Public aviation weather cams at dozens of Canadian airports, refreshed every 10 minutes for pilots.
subject: Multiple Canadian airport runways/approach views
notes: Aggregator for ~100+ Canadian airports; image refresh ~10 min, not a video stream.

title: x-post from Self, tons of Japanese webcams.
description: A StarDot NetCam SC-style neighborhood webcam hosted in Saitama, Japan. MJPEG stream at 640x480; part of a long list of Japanese public webcams the OP aggregated.
subject: Japanese neighborhood street
notes: StarDot's nphMotionJpeg endpoint signature confirmed. Companion list at ne.jp/asahi/neko/maru/linkcam04.htm.

title: Marina
description: A personal marina webcam in Trondheim, Norway, served from a dynamic DNS hostname. MJPEG stream over an unusual high port (9876) on a residential/business NAT.
isp: Dynamic DNS (dyndns.org) on residential Norwegian ISP
subject: Trondheim marina / boat moorings
notes: hoybakken.dyndns.org - high port 9876 suggests home NVR; not verified live recently.

title: College of charleston, sc.
description: YouTube live stream of the College of Charleston campus in South Carolina. Multiple views (campus, northeast) re-streamed to YouTube.
subject: College of Charleston campus
notes: Two YouTube live IDs: campus view (ukJdF27YDVg) and northeast view (Mf_4c_8uVoI).

title: Baker Tower Webcam, Dartmouth
description: Dartmouth College's Baker Tower webcam, hosted at wc2.dartmouth.edu. MJPEG stream looking over the Baker Memorial Library tower and the Hanover green.
subject: Baker Memorial Library tower and Dartmouth green
notes: Long-running campus cam. Newer MJPEG URL points to wc2.dartmouth.htmld.edu (a typo for dartmouth.edu).

title: VCU Ramcam (Richmond, VA)
description: Virginia Commonwealth University's 'Ramcam' hosted on a custom subdomain. AXIS camera (image.cgi snapshot endpoint) overlooking the Student Commons and Compass Plaza on the Monroe Park campus.
subject: VCU Student Commons / Compass Plaza
notes: Static JPEG endpoint; companion view at cabell.ramcam.vcu.edu.

title: Webcam Saint-Maurice - Gorgeous even at night.
description: A privately hosted AXIS webcam in Saint-Maurice, France, served over dynamic DNS on a non-standard port. Static MJPEG stream; popular at night for its illumination.
subject: Saint-Maurice, France street scene (night/dusk views)
notes: Port 16251 suggests a routed/NAT setup behind a French residential ISP.

title: University of Oregon
description: University of Oregon weatherSTEM sky camera over the Memorial Quad in Eugene. Skycam with 360° wide-angle, refreshes as a JPEG snapshot for weather observation.
subject: UO Memorial Quad skycam
notes: Snapshot endpoint; companion cam west Eugene (uo/west/snapshot.jpg).

title: Flight line prescott AZ Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
description: ERAU Prescott's flagship airport camera overlooking Ernest A. Love Field (KPRC) runway, taxiway and the Embry-Riddle flight line. AXIS P5415-E PTZ dome, anonymous PTZ is enabled.
subject: Prescott Regional Airport (KPRC) flight line
notes: PTZ anonymous; root.PTZ.BoaProtPTZOperator=anonymous. See docs/AXIS_FLIGHTCAM1_P5415E.md.

title: city in Iceland?

subject: Akureyri town centre and Eyjafjörður fjord
notes: Original URL redirects to YouTube live (GXTycxKz_FQ).

title: Hammerfest Kommune
description: AXIS MJPEG webcam operated by Hammerfest municipality in northern Norway. Static view of the town, one of the world's northernmost municipalities.
subject: Hammerfest town / harbour
notes: Direct IP, port 80, no auth. Investigated entry.

title: Looks like a mall?
description: An AXIS viewer page (login-gated) hosted on a European IP. The OP thought it looked like a mall; precise subject is uncertain because the cam requires credentials.
subject: Unknown interior (possibly a mall)
notes: REQUIRES LOGIN per OP. Direct IP, 194.x = RIPE allocation commonly Sweden.

title: Kill Devil, NC
description: Town of Kill Devil Hills official Wright Brothers National Memorial cam. 1920x1080 H.264, ~30 fps HLS via IPCamLive, token-rotated stream served from s165.ipcamlive.com.
subject: Wright Brothers National Memorial
notes: Token rotates. See docs/KDHNC_WEBCAMS.md. Companion Ocean Bay Blvd cam is Surfline-embedded.

title: University of Wyoming
description: University of Wyoming's legacy StarDot NetCam-based weather cam. 1296x960 MJPEG at ~25 fps, served from actbwebcam.uwyo.edu via nph-mjpeg.cgi and nph-jpeg.cgi.
subject: UWyo campus weather cam
notes: See docs/UWYO_AND_WANETA_CAMS.md. Legacy Java applet UI but the MJPEG CGI still works.

title: Purdue Webcams
description: Aggregator of Purdue University (West Lafayette, IN) public webcams - residence hall dining halls, campus views, athletics, etc.
subject: Multiple Purdue campus cams
notes: Aggregator script showCams.py.

title: Opentopia - lots of unsecured webcams from around the world
description: Opentopia's hidden-cam directory indexes unsecured public webcams worldwide (with owner permission). An early-2010s directory of MJPEG/snapshot cams in homes, shops, beaches, etc.
subject: Aggregator of unsecured public webcams
notes: Aggregator; many listed cams are now offline.

title: Wired New York Webcam 1 in Orion building
description: Originally a static JPEG webcam in the Orion building (350 W42nd St) looking south down the Hudson River, Statue of Liberty upper-left, Lincoln Tunnel ramps centre. StarDot NetCam XL installed 2007-03-02.
subject: Hudson River, Statue of Liberty, Lincoln Tunnel ramps
notes: DEAD since 2012-07-05. Java applet polls same frozen JPEG. See docs/WIRED_NEW_YORK_WEBCAMS.md.

title: Dinocam!!!
description: YouTube live 'Dinocam' from the South Dakota School of Mines & Technology (SDSM&T) in Rapid City, showing the famous dinosaur statues on campus.
subject: SDSM&T campus dinosaurs
notes: Dino statues on SDSM&T campus.

title: Soltorget Pajala

subject: Pajala town square (Soltorget)
notes: Two stream endpoints; mjpg low FPS, media.cgi H.264 25 fps. See docs/AXIS_CAM_195_196_36_242.md.

title: Stein SG.

subject: Stein village square in Toggenburg
notes: Port 8008 suggests router port-forward. Stein SG merged into Nesslau on 2013-01-01.

title: Steve's ant farm (the ants aren't looking so hot)

subject: Ant farm
notes: Personal/hobbyist ant-farm cam.

subject: KPRC flight line
notes: Direct MJPEG stream endpoint.

title: Public AXIS P1447-LE Network Camera - Swedish Residential Square (no auth)

subject: Pajala town square (Soltorget)
notes: 5MP, 25 fps, H.264 + MJPEG. See docs/AXIS_CAM_195_196_36_242.md.

subject: Pajala town square
